audio_role: Upbeat trendy background track with a soft pop/click on each time a new item lands on the tray; no voice, no sizzle, music just keeps the build playful and marks each addition.
can_make: We can make all of it in edit. Start from one real overhead photo of an empty tray on a table. Cut out real menu photos of drink, loaded fries, tenders, dip cup, burger and pop them on one by one with scale-pop animation timed to an animated cursor moving across top emojis. Add the emoji row on top in edit. If we want a model, have a house cast hand slide the full tray forward in a 4 s AI clip started from the final tray photo, but no eating, no cooking needed.
core: You click a picture menu and the real tray builds itself item by item.
dish: Popeyes combo tray: cola with ice, pulled-pork loaded fries, 2 breaded chicken tenders, small BBQ beans dip, chicken burger with cheese and tomato.
fits: Fast-food combos, burger + sides sets, chicken shops, loaded fries, kids menus, any place that sells a fixed tray with 4-5 pieces.
hook: Empty tray below, five big food emojis floating above, white cursor moves to the drink in the first second and a real cola cup pops onto the tray.

shots.action: soda cup, loaded fries, chicken tenders, sauce cup and burger appear one by one on the empty tray
shots.camera: locked-off static, slight push in on the full tray at the end
shots.framing: medium wide overhead on table tray

text_on_screen: No words. Only five floating emojis on top: drink, fries, drumstick, chicken strips, burger plus a white cursor arrow that moves from one emoji to the next.
why_it_works: You see each piece land separately so you register quantity and texture: cold soda ice, cheese and meat on fries, crust on tenders, glossy burger bun. It ends on a full, crowded tray, which looks like value and choice.
